intro: Request-level test cases for the Stage-1 intake API. Every row is a literal HTTP request (method, path, headers, body) with the exact status code and response fields to check. Ready-made requests: procurement.postman_collection.json.
notes: Every endpoint requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for a Direct Manager or Managing Director — there is no anonymous access anywhere in this module.

**Known build note:** the byte-identical re-upload shortcut (instant replay / 409 `duplicate_content`) is disabled in this build — the service marks it "TESTING PHASE". Until it is re-enabled, re-POSTing the same bytes re-runs full validation instead of short-circuiting. OS-B1 / OS-B2 depend on this; confirm current behaviour before filing either as a bug.

Every 4xx/5xx upload response carries a `reason_code`: unsupported_mime (415), file_too_large (413), empty_or_corrupt (422), virus_detected (422), scanner_unavailable (503), not_an_order_sheet / not_a_spec_sheet / wrong_slot / needs_manual_review (422), submission_locked (409), duplicate_content (409).
`force=true` only ever overrides `needs_manual_review`. It is ignored for every hard reject.
The ORDER slot is the only slot that locks, and the only slot that gates Stage-2 readiness. The SPEC slot never locks and never gates on its own.

cases.title: Open with no client
cases.expected: 201; body {"submission_id":"<uuid>","status":"open"}

cases.title: Open with a client_id
cases.expected: 201; same shape as A‑P1 — the client link isn't echoed here, verify via GET status later.

cases.title: MD opens a submission
cases.expected: 201, identical shape.

cases.title: Wrong role
cases.expected: 403 Forbidden.

cases.title: No/invalid token
steps: (no Authorization header, or an expired/garbage token)
cases.expected: 401 Unauthorized.

cases.title: Malformed client_id
cases.expected: 422 — Pydantic UUID coercion failure.

cases.title: Many opens in a row
cases.expected: Each call returns a distinct submission_id; no error, no rate limit observed at this volume.

cases.title: A client-less submission still accepts uploads
steps: (valid order-sheet file, no client on the submission)
cases.expected: Upload proceeds and validates normally — client_id only narrows which client_template profile is checked first, it's never a precondition.

cases.title: Valid PDF, onboarded client
cases.expected: 201; document.validation.status:"accepted", method:"heuristic", slot filled in the returned submission summary.

cases.title: Valid XLSX
cases.expected: 201, accepted.

cases.title: Valid CSV
cases.expected: 201, accepted.

cases.title: Valid legacy .xls
cases.expected: 201, accepted — read via the xlrd fallback path.

cases.title: Scanned PDF, genuinely valid
cases.expected: 201 or 422 depending on OCR/LLM outcome — method:"llm" if it escalated and passed; check validation_signals shows OCR text was used, not an instant reject just because there's no text layer.

cases.title: Mid-confidence genuine document
cases.expected: Resolves to a real verdict (accepted, rejected, or needs_manual_review) with method:"llm" — not stuck, not a timeout.

cases.title: Unsupported file type
cases.expected: 415; reason_code:"unsupported_mime".

cases.title: Disguised file (extension lies)
cases.expected: 415; reason_code:"unsupported_mime" — sniffed content wins over the extension.

cases.title: Oversized file
cases.expected: 413; reason_code:"file_too_large" — returned while streaming, before the pipeline runs.

cases.title: Zero-byte upload
cases.expected: 422; reason_code:"empty_or_corrupt".

cases.title: Corrupted file
cases.expected: 422; reason_code:"empty_or_corrupt", no 500.

cases.title: EICAR virus test string
steps: file=@eicar.txt  (the standard EICAR test signature, renamed .pdf/.csv)
cases.expected: 422; reason_code:"virus_detected", payload.scan_signature present. Cross-check an AuditLog row with action:"VIRUS_DETECTED" was written (ask backend/DB access if you can't query directly).

cases.title: Scanner unreachable
cases.expected: 503; reason_code:"scanner_unavailable" — confirm no document/storage row was created (fail closed, nothing stored unscanned).

cases.title: Narrative document quoting real client refs
steps: file=@process_workflow_writeup.pdf  (prose PDF, section headings, mentions real order numbers)
cases.expected: 422; reason_code:"not_an_order_sheet", method:"heuristic", signals_found mentions "flowing narrative text" / section headings.

cases.title: Right document, wrong slot
steps: file=@spec_sheet_valid.pdf  (a real SPEC sheet, posted to the ORDER slot)
cases.expected: 422; reason_code:"wrong_slot", suggested_fix names the correct slot.

cases.title: Unrelated document
cases.expected: 422; reason_code:"not_an_order_sheet".

cases.title: Exactly at the size limit
cases.expected: Not rejected for size — processes normally (only strictly > the cap 413s).

cases.title: A few KB over the limit
cases.expected: 413; reason_code:"file_too_large".

cases.title: PDF with a sliver of text (near the 40-char text-layer bar)
cases.expected: Treated as scanned (is_scanned_pdf:true in signals) and escalated via OCR, not scored as if it had a real text layer.

cases.title: Right on the heuristic accept/reject boundary
steps: file=@order_sheet_borderline.pdf  (weakly matches the client's fingerprint terms)
cases.expected: method:"llm" in the response — escalated instead of guessed at the heuristic layer.

cases.title: No file extension
steps: file=@order  (valid PDF bytes, filename has no extension)
cases.expected: Classified purely on sniffed content — extension-agreement check is skipped when there's no extension.

cases.title: Mixed/uppercase extension
cases.expected: Recognized the same as lowercase — no unsupported_mime from casing alone.

cases.title: "Needs review" is a distinct outcome
cases.expected: 422; validation.status:"needs_manual_review", validation.can_override:true, override_hint text present — never silently 201'd or silently a hard reject.

cases.title: Client-vocabulary vs. generic-English diagnostics
steps: 1) file rejected for an onboarded non-English client
2) same bad file, submission with NO client onboarded
cases.expected: validation.signals_expected differs between the two — (1) lists that client's own anchor terms, (2) falls back to the generic English list.

cases.title: Graceful degrade with no classifier configured
cases.expected: 422; validation.status:"needs_manual_review", method:"heuristic" — not a 500, not a hang.

cases.title: Illegible scan degrades safely
cases.expected: 422; validation.status:"needs_manual_review" — not force-guessed accept or reject.

cases.title: Accept into a fresh submission
cases.expected: 201; submission summary shows order_sheet.present:true, ready_for_stage_2:true (order alone is enough — OS‑L1).

cases.title: Correct with a re-upload before consumption
cases.expected: 201 on step 2; GET .../documents/{doc A} now shows validation.status:"superseded".

cases.title: Direct upload, no submission yet
cases.expected: 201; response's submission_id is a NEW id — capture it for the paired spec-sheet upload.

cases.title: Force-accept a needs_manual_review order sheet
cases.expected: Step 2 → 201; document.validation.status:"accepted", validation_signals.manual_override:true.

cases.title: Change the order sheet after consumption
steps: [submission.status already "consumed" — order was claimed by the style breakdown]
cases.expected: 409; reason_code:"submission_locked".

cases.title: force=true on a hard reject
cases.expected: Still 415; reason_code:"unsupported_mime" — force is ignored for anything that isn't needs_manual_review.

cases.title: Unknown submission id
cases.expected: 404 "Submission not found."

cases.title: Re-POST the identical file twice
cases.expected: Per the build note: currently re-runs full validation again (still 201) rather than an instant replay. Confirm this is the intended current state — the designed behaviour (dedupe enabled) is a short-circuit replay of the cached verdict.

cases.title: Same bytes already accepted in the OTHER slot
cases.expected: Designed behaviour (dedupe enabled): 409, error:"duplicate_content". Currently may instead re-validate per the build note — record whichever you observe.

cases.title: Readiness needs ONLY the order slot
cases.expected: Step 2 → status:"complete", ready_for_stage_2:true, spec_sheet.present:false — a spec sheet is not required here.

cases.title: A spec uploaded first still lands, doesn't gate
cases.expected: Step 2 → spec_sheet.present:true but status:"open", ready_for_stage_2:false — the order slot is the only gate.

cases.title: Accept at any time
steps: file=@spec_sheet_valid.pdf   (try both before AND after the order slot is filled)
cases.expected: 201 either way; spec_sheet.present:true.

cases.title: Direct upload, no submission yet
cases.expected: 201; new submission_id returned.

cases.title: Force-accept needs_manual_review
cases.expected: 201; validation_signals.manual_override:true.

cases.title: force=true on a hard reject
cases.expected: Still 422 virus_detected — override never applies to a hard reject.

cases.title: Upload after the order is already locked
cases.expected: 201 — spec slot is deliberately never locked, unlike the order slot.

cases.title: Spec-only submission stays "open"
cases.expected: Step 2 → status:"open", ready_for_stage_2:false, blocking lists "order_sheet missing".

cases.title: spec_type correctly told apart
cases.expected: Each document's validation.spec_type reflects its own kind (measurement grid vs. narrative tech pack) — check via GET .../documents/{id}.

cases.title: Fresh, empty submission
cases.expected: 200; order_sheet.present:false, spec_sheet.present:false, ready_for_stage_2:false, blocking:["order_sheet missing","spec_sheet missing"].

cases.title: After order accepted
cases.expected: 200; status:"complete", ready_for_stage_2:true, order_sheet.present:true.

cases.title: After both slots accepted
cases.expected: 200; both slots present:true, still ready.

cases.title: Status right after a supersede
steps: 2) re-upload → doc B accepted, A superseded
cases.expected: Reflects doc B only — superseded doc A doesn't affect the slot state either way.

cases.title: Accepted but scan status not clean
steps: [a slot's doc has validation_status=accepted but scan_status outside clean/skipped — needs a DB/test-fixture setup, ask backend for a seeded case]
cases.expected: blocking includes an entry like "order_sheet scan_status=...", called out separately from the validation status.

cases.title: blocking[] is always human-readable
steps: (run against several submissions in different incomplete states)
cases.expected: Every non-ready case includes specific plain-text reasons in blocking — never just a bare boolean with no explanation.

cases.title: Report for an accepted doc
cases.expected: 200; document.validation.status:"accepted", confidence, method, classified_as populated.

cases.title: Report for a rejected doc
cases.expected: 200; validation.status:"rejected", reason_code, signals_expected vs signals_found, suggested_fix text.

cases.title: Document belongs to a different submission
cases.expected: 404 "Document not found in this submission." — must NOT leak the document via the wrong submission.

cases.title: Superseded doc keeps its own original verdict
steps: 1) doc A accepted, then superseded by doc B
cases.expected: Still shows doc A's ORIGINAL verdict/signals as recorded at the time — not overwritten to match doc B.

sections.title: End-to-end sequences
sections.sub: chained calls across the endpoints above

cases.title: Straight-through happy path
cases.expected: 201 → 201 → 200 ready, no manual step needed anywhere.

cases.title: Reject → correct → re-upload → accept
cases.expected: A rejected slot is fully recoverable within the SAME submission by re-POSTing the fixed file.

cases.title: Pair two direct uploads
steps: 2) POST /upload/spec-sheet?...  (NOTE: /upload/spec-sheet does NOT take a submission_id param — instead POST POST /submissions/{captured_id}/spec-sheet, file=@spec_sheet_valid.pdf)
cases.expected: Both documents land on the SAME submission — verify via GET /submissions/{captured_id} showing both slots present.

cases.title: Manual-review override end to end
cases.expected: Same submission recovers from "needs review" straight into "accepted" without starting over.

cases.title: Locked order forces a fresh submission
cases.expected: The 409 has a clear, actionable path forward — a new submission, not a dead end.
